_label: PHASE 3 BATCH 1 — remaining Moon-house application claims; universal, development only, practitioner review required
scope: Moon houses 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11. Houses 3, 4 and 12 remain in the existing Denver, Chicago and Lisbon overlays and are not duplicated here.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Research history, technical doctrine, source gaps and prohibited extensions remain internal trace.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Your changing emotional state may be closely connected with how they meet life and how others initially experience their presence.
Understanding personal reactions and emotional rhythms may be an important part of developing a stable sense of self.
You may sometimes need to distinguish a temporary feeling from a lasting truth about who they are.

compositionRequirements: Every Moon-in-first application must be combined with the admitted Moon-sign record; first-house placement alone cannot define your identity or sensitivity.
prohibitedExtensions: claim that emotions are always visible
personality conclusion without the Moon-sign modifier

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Emotional steadiness may be connected with a dependable sense of support, resources and continuity.
Tone of voice and the way feelings are spoken may carry particular emotional significance.
Family or inherited values may help shape what you associates with safety and belonging, without determining the actual family history.
Development may involve building security without allowing temporary material uncertainty to define personal worth.

prohibitedExtensions: wealth, poverty, inheritance or financial-loss prediction
claim about your actual family history

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: The mind may have a strong reflective or interpretive capacity when engaging with something personally meaningful.
Creative expression may become emotionally important because it gives inner experience a form that can be developed and shared.
Play, personal interests or experiences of heartfelt enjoyment may help restore emotional vitality.
Caring for, teaching or encouraging younger people or creative work may carry emotional meaning, without predicting parenthood.

prohibitedExtensions: claim that you must become a parent

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Irritation may arise more quickly when responsibilities, conflict or ongoing demands create emotional strain.
Daily routines and the conditions surrounding regular work may have a noticeable effect on emotional steadiness.
A sense of making a useful contribution may support your state of mind when it does not require ignoring personal limits.
Development may involve creating sustainable routines and responding to pressure before frustration accumulates.

compositionRequirements: APP-MOON-6-STRAIN-REACTIVITY must appear with APP-MOON-6-SUSTAINABLE-PRACTICE or another constructive admitted claim.
prohibitedExtensions: medical, appetite, weakness or illness prediction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Close relationships may be experienced with strong emotional intensity rather than emotional neutrality.
Your state of mind may be affected by the quality of exchange within important one-to-one relationships.
You may sometimes need to separate their own emotional needs from the feelings or responses of someone close to them.
Development may involve naming personal needs directly while leaving room for mutual response and negotiation.

prohibitedExtensions: marriage, divorce, betrayal or partner prediction
dependency or inability to be alone

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Some emotional experiences may require privacy and time before you are ready to explain them.
Trust may influence how readily you shares emotionally significant or vulnerable material.
Periods of major change may prompt deep emotional processing around what can be retained and what must be allowed to change.
Development may involve honoring emotional depth without allowing uncertainty or past pain to become the only lens through which the present is understood.

prohibitedExtensions: death, longevity, inheritance or crisis prediction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Emotional steadiness may be supported by a sense that life has meaning, direction or a larger context.
Beliefs, ethics or spiritual questions may be processed personally and emotionally rather than remaining purely abstract ideas.
Study, teachers, travel or exposure to unfamiliar perspectives may help you reconsider what they feel and believe.
Development may involve allowing beliefs to mature through experience instead of demanding one permanent answer to every question.

prohibitedExtensions: guaranteed fortune, prosperity or higher education
claim that one belief system is correct

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: The mind may be strongly engaged by undertaking visible responsibilities and bringing important efforts toward completion.
Progress in meaningful work may contribute to emotional satisfaction, without guaranteeing recognition or success.
You may need to distinguish genuine purpose from the changing approval or expectations of the public environment.
Development may involve defining accomplishment through meaningful contribution as well as external results.

prohibitedExtensions: career, fame, status, wealth or promotion prediction
claim that public approval is emotionally necessary

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Friendships, groups or communities may contribute to your sense of emotional belonging.
Working toward an aspiration with other people may help you feel connected to something beyond immediate personal concerns.
Because social needs and aspirations can change, you may periodically reassess which communities still feel emotionally aligned.
Development may involve choosing friendships and collective goals that support genuine connection rather than belonging at any cost.

prohibitedExtensions: income, gains, popularity or social-status prediction
claim about the number or quality of friendships
claim that changing friendships indicates betrayal

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively without modifying the frozen Lisbon, Chicago or Denver overlays.
Do not duplicate the existing Moon-house 3, 4 or 12 application records.
Route claims exclusively from their purposes fields; no house-specific claim ID may be hard-coded in planner or writer logic.
Preserve each classification and expose it in internal trace.
For any record with supersedesForDevelopment, restore the original gap prohibition in production.
Production must admit zero claims from this file until individual practitioner approval changes productionEligible.
Unused admitted claims must be logged as ADMITTED_NOT_USED without causing a warning or failure.
The writer must name a nakshatra once only; the following pada introduction must not repeat the nakshatra name.
